title: the child ledger reaches no network to reach a verdict

Every number is computed in this process from the files on this disk. No
network call, no hosted service and no account takes part in reaching an exit
code.

This entry is here so the child contributes an enforceable unit of its own. A
child whose only enforceable entry came from its parent would make the enforced
count and the citation the same fact, and the leak test could not tell a check
that read both ledgers from one that read only the parent.
